summary: AI Workspace feature tested end-to-end. All 9 backend pytest cases passed (stats shape+seed=6, search text/type/sort/oldest, versions with proposal+plan multi-version, org isolation between two demo tenants, and proposal generate regression with gen_ms+project_name metadata). Frontend flow verified via Playwright: /ai-history redirects to /ai-workspace, page renders all 8 sections (header, lifetime saved, 5-card stats grid, sparkline, quick actions, search+3 filters, timeline with 6 seeded items, insights, version compare). Search filter narrows to 2 items for 'Northwind', type=proposal returns 2 items, sort/range filters trigger requests. Version-compare dialog opens with 2 versions and 'Open side-by-side compare' navigates to /projects/{id}?tab=proposal. Sidebar 'AI Workspace' nav item present. Zero critical issues.

issues: Radix a11y console warning: DialogContent missing aria-describedby/Description. Non-blocking, but easy fix: add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby prop.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription to ai-workspace-compare-dialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: workspace_search $or regex uses re.escape on q (good). But 'client_name'/'project_name' are only set on newer activities via meta; older backfilled entries may not match — acceptable given seed always sets them.
workspace_versions plans branch: sorts arr by version ascending then takes arr[-1] as current — correct. Consider capping to avoid loading all plans/proposals into memory in a large tenant.
AIWorkspace.jsx renders 'select' options only when types array is populated; on first render types is [] until first search response arrives — filter works, minor cosmetic delay only.
test_credentials: No credentials needed — provisioned via POST /api/auth/demo (accessToken in response body).
seed_data_creation: Demo tenant seed provides 3 clients, 2 projects, 3 tasks, 6 ai_activities, versioned proposal (v1+v2) and plan (v1+v2) — verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Workspace endpoints are stable. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_ai_workspace.py can be reused as regression. Frontend testids to remember: ai-workspace-page, ai-workspace-lifetime-saved, ai-workspace-search-input, ai-workspace-filter-type/range/sort, ai-workspace-item, ai-workspace-version-item, ai-workspace-compare-dialog, ai-workspace-open-compare, quick-action-{path}. Demo login: click [data-testid='explore-demo-btn'] on /login; JWT is at response.accessToken.
